quotes.text: 12 of our 13 Director nominees are independent.

The Board of Directors of HP Inc. (the “Board”) currently consists of 15 members (the “Directors”). On the recommendation of the Nominating, Governance and Social Responsibility (“NGSR”) Committee, the Board has nominated the 13 persons named below for election as Directors this year, each to serve for a one-year term and until the Director’s successor is elected and qualified or, if earlier, until his or her resignation or removal.
